verdict.rationale: Notion's marketing explicitly claims 'Get answers, instantly—with citations' (Notion Q&A/AI feature), directly matching the story, but there's no first-party documentation detail or independent/hands-on evidence describing how citations are generated, their accuracy, or workspace coverage. Missing for 10: detailed product documentation of the Q&A citation feature, independent verification/hands-on reports of citation accuracy and reliability, and confirmation of scope across full workspace content.
